title: Connect ChatGPT Dot to Even G2 | Dot Link
description: Dot Link is an open-source app connecting your existing ChatGPT Dot to Even Realities G2 smart glasses. Talk, type, and read replies through your own Mac relay.
socialDescription: Your Dot, now on Even G2. Talk through your glasses, type on your iPhone, and read replies at a glance. Open source, with your own Mac as the relay.

philosophy: Most AI waits for you to ask. ChatGPT Dot can speak up when something matters, and stay quiet when nothing does.
